name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began in his teens, fueled by a passion for engineering and a fascination with speed. He apprenticed at a local racing team, honing his fabrication skills and learning the intricacies of race car construction. Over the years, he's worked on a variety of projects, from restoring classic racing cars to developing innovative aerodynamic components for Formula teams. 

Alistair is known for his meticulous approach and unwavering commitment to quality. He believes that precision and attention to detail are paramount in ensuring both performance and safety. He is driven by the challenge of pushing the boundaries of what's possible and finding creative solutions to complex engineering problems. Alistair's distinctive ability lies in his talent to blend traditional fabrication techniques with cutting-edge technologies, making him a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.description: Alistair is a stocky man with a focused gaze and a permanent smudge of grease on his cheek.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an absurd point.
Insists on using imperial measurements alongside metric.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters adorning his workspace.
